title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines
scope: This standard provides guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes to achieve specified strength, workability and durability.
description: Used to design a concrete mix for a given grade and exposure condition. Works alongside IS 456 for structural concrete.

title: Common Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for common burnt clay building bricks used in buildings and structures.
description: Specifies dimensions, compressive strength classes, water absorption and efflorescence limits for ordinary masonry bricks.

title: Fresh Concrete - Methods of Sampling, Testing and Analysis - Part 1: Sampling
scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling fresh concrete for testing, including sample size, frequency and handling.
description: Defines how concrete samples are taken at the point of placement so that strength test results are representative.

title: Two Part Polysulphide Sealants - Part 1: Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for two part polysulphide based sealants used for sealing joints in building construction.
description: Movement joint sealant specified in facades, expansion joints and glazing.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade - Specification
scope: This standard specifies the manufacture, chemical composition, physical properties, and testing protocols for high-strength 53 grade ordinary Portland cement.
description: Designed specifically for heavy infrastructure projects, high-rise building load-bearing frames, prestressed concrete sleepers, and high-strength concrete mixes (M35 and above). Delivers rapid early strength gain and a minimum 28-day compressive strength of 53 MPa. Favored for fast-track construction cycles and precast girder plants.

title: Sulphate Resisting Portland Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for sulphate resisting Portland cement intended for use where concrete is exposed to sulphate attack.
description: Specified for foundations in sulphate-bearing soils and for structures exposed to sulphate-rich groundwater or effluent.

title: Pulverized Fuel Ash-Lime Bricks (Fly Ash Bricks) - Specification
scope: This standard prescribes requirements for solid and hollow bricks manufactured from pulverized fuel ash, lime, and sand or stone dust.
description: Eco-friendly sustainable masonry units for internal and external structural walls in commercial and institutional developments. Offers high dimensional uniformity, sharp edges, and uniform light-gray texture requiring minimal plaster thickness. Delivers high compressive strength and low water absorption compared to traditional kiln-burnt bricks.

title: Fibres for Use in Fibre Reinforced Concrete - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for steel and synthetic fibres used in fibre reinforced concrete.
description: Specifies fibre geometry, tensile strength and dosage for fibre reinforced concrete in slabs, tunnels and precast.

title: Non-Destructive Testing of Concrete - Methods of Test - Part 1: Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity
scope: This standard covers the determination of ultrasonic pulse velocity through concrete for assessing quality and uniformity.
description: Used to assess in-situ concrete quality, detect voids and cracking, without cutting cores.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification (Part 1: Fly Ash Based)
scope: This standard covers the manufacture, chemical, and physical characteristics of Portland Pozzolana Cement utilizing siliceous fly ash pozzolana.
description: Optimized for hydraulic dams, marine retaining walls, coastal mass concreting, and sewage treatment structures prone to sulfate and chloride attacks. Replaces clinker with processed fly ash to significantly lower heat of hydration and reduce thermal cracking in mass pours. Produces dense, impermeable concrete matrix with prolonged ultimate strength gain.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification (Part 2: Calcined Clay Based)
scope: This standard specifies the requirements for Portland Pozzolana Cement manufactured using calcined clay as the pozzolanic constituent.
description: Suitable for general masonry, soil stabilization, and hydraulic foundation structures where pozzolanic reactivity is derived from thermally activated clays. Exhibits excellent resistance to aggressive groundwater chemical action and alkali-silica reaction. Provides superior plasticity and cohesion in mortar mixes.

title: Sand for Masonry Mortars - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for sand used in masonry mortars.
description: Specifies grading and permissible deleterious content for mortar sand, distinct from concrete sand under IS 383.

title: Autoclaved Cellular (Aerated) Concrete Blocks - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for precast autoclaved aerated concrete (AAC) lightweight blocks for use in load-bearing and non-load bearing wall masonry.
description: Engineered lightweight building blocks offering exceptional thermal insulation, fire resistance, and seismic load reduction for multi-story residential towers. Formulated with quartz sand/fly ash slurry and aluminum foaming agent subjected to high-pressure steam autoclaving. Drastically accelerates construction speed compared to conventional red clay bricks.

title: Preparation and Use of Masonry Mortars - Code of Practice
scope: This standard covers the preparation, proportioning and use of mortars for masonry construction.
description: Governs mortar mix proportions and workmanship for brick and block masonry.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 1: Particle Size and Shape
scope: This standard prescribes the methods of test for determining particle size distribution, flakiness index and elongation index of aggregates.
description: Test method used to demonstrate that aggregate supplied under IS 383 meets its grading and shape requirements.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 3: Specific Gravity, Density, Voids, Absorption and Bulking
scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determination of specific gravity, density, voids, absorption and bulking of aggregates.
description: Provides the aggregate properties needed for concrete mix design under IS 10262.

title: Methods of Test for Aggregates for Concrete - Part 4: Mechanical Properties
scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determination of aggregate crushing value, impact value and abrasion value.
description: Strength and durability tests for aggregate, particularly relevant to pavement and heavy-duty concrete.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 33 Grade - Specification
scope: This standard prescribes requirements for 33 grade ordinary Portland cement for general civil masonry and plain concrete work.
description: Historic formulation for low-stress plain concrete, flooring base courses, and single-story masonry footings. Formally consolidated and superseded by the unified composite cement standard IS 269:2015. Maintained for archival reference and conservation work on heritage structures.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement (33, 43, and 53 Grades) - Unified Specification
scope: This comprehensive standard specifies the manufacturing requirements, chemical composition limits, and mechanical strength grades for 33, 43, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement.
description: The unified national standard governing all standard OPC manufacturing in India, consolidating previously fragmented grade specifications under unified quality control benchmarks. Mandates rigorous particle fineness, setting time bounds, and sound test parameters. Supersedes the standalone legacy 1989 standards.

title: Masonry Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for masonry cement intended for use in masonry mortar and plaster.
description: A cement formulated for improved workability and water retention in mortars rather than for structural concrete.

title: Methods of Tests of Burnt Clay Building Bricks - Part 1: Determination of Compressive Strength
scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the compressive strength of burnt clay building bricks.
description: The acceptance test demonstrating that bricks supplied under IS 1077 meet their strength class.

title: Methods of Sampling Hydraulic Cement
scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling hydraulic cement for the purpose of testing.
description: Defines how cement is sampled from bags, silos and bulk carriers so that test results represent the consignment.

title: Methods of Tests for Concrete Pipes
scope: This standard covers the methods of test for concrete pipes, including hydrostatic, three-edge bearing and permeability tests.
description: The acceptance tests demonstrating that pipes supplied under IS 458 meet their class requirements.

title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for aggregates, both coarse and fine, derived from natural sources and manufactured sources, for use in concrete.
description: Governs the grading, quality and permissible deleterious content of aggregate used in concrete. Referenced by IS 456 for all concrete work.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 1: Determination of Fineness by Dry Sieving
scope: This standard covers the method for determination of fineness of hydraulic cement by dry sieving.
description: One of the acceptance tests demonstrating that supplied cement meets the fineness its specification requires.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 4: Determination of Consistency of Standard Cement Paste
scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the consistency of standard cement paste.
description: Establishes the water content used in the setting time and soundness tests for cement.

title: Methods of Physical Tests for Hydraulic Cement - Part 5: Determination of Initial and Final Setting Times
scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the initial and final setting times of hydraulic cement.
description: Setting time governs how long concrete remains workable after mixing; an acceptance test for supplied cement.

title: Method of Chemical Analysis of Hydraulic Cement
scope: This standard covers the methods of chemical analysis of hydraulic cement, including determination of major oxide constituents.
description: The chemical acceptance test for cement, covering lime saturation factor, alumina ratio and insoluble residue.

title: Portland Slag Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the manufacture, chemical and physical requirements for Portland slag cement made by grinding Portland cement clinker with granulated blast furnace slag.
description: A blended cement offering improved sulphate resistance and lower heat of hydration, widely used in marine and mass concrete works.

title: Precast Concrete Pipes (With and Without Reinforcement) - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for precast concrete pipes, with and without reinforcement, for the conveyance of sewage, rainwater and drainage.
description: Specifies classes, dimensions, strength and testing for concrete pipes used in drainage and sewerage works.

title: Concrete Batching and Mixing Plant - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for concrete batching and mixing plant, including accuracy of weighing and mixing efficiency.
description: Specifies the plant used to produce concrete under IS 4926, including batching tolerances.

title: Ready-Mixed Concrete - Code of Practice
scope: This standard covers the requirements for ready-mixed concrete, including materials, production, transport, delivery and acceptance.
description: Applies IS 456 requirements to concrete produced off site and delivered to the works.

title: Ready-Mixed Concrete (RMC) - Code of Practice for Production and Quality Control
scope: This standard specifies requirements for the computerized batching, mixing, transport, sampling, and quality verification of concrete supplied in plastic and unhardened condition from commercial RMC batching plants.
description: Mandatory compliance benchmark for automated transit mixer concrete supplied directly to civil construction sites. Enforces strict automated weighing precision, water-cement ratio control, and transit drum agitation time limits to preserve workability. Guarantees consistent cube compressive strength and standardized slump retention.

title: Plywood for Concrete Shuttering Work - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for plywood used as formwork or shuttering for concrete work.
description: Specifies film-faced and plain shuttering plywood, including bond quality and number of reuses.

title: Hardened Concrete - Methods of Test
scope: This standard covers the methods of test for determining the compressive, flexural and split tensile strength of hardened concrete.
description: The acceptance test for concrete strength on site. Cube and cylinder testing to this standard is normally a contractual requirement.

title: Methods for Sampling of Clay Building Bricks
scope: This standard covers the method of sampling clay building bricks for the purpose of testing.
description: Defines lot sizes and sample numbers so that brick test results represent the consignment.

title: High Alumina Cement for Structural Use - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for high alumina cement intended for structural use.
description: Rapid strength gain and refractory properties; used in specialised structural and high-temperature applications.

title: Standard Sand for Testing Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for standard sand used in testing the strength of cement.
description: The reference sand used so that cement strength results are comparable between laboratories.

title: Supersulphated Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for supersulphated cement manufactured by intergrinding granulated blast furnace slag with calcium sulphate.
description: A specialised cement with high resistance to sulphate and acidic environments.

title: Rapid Hardening Portland Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for rapid hardening Portland cement, which attains higher early strength than ordinary Portland cement.
description: Used where early formwork removal or rapid return to service is required.

title: Hydrophobic Portland Cement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the chemical and physical requirements for hydrophobic Portland cement manufactured with hydrophobic film-forming chemical additives.
description: Formulated for prolonged warehouse storage and transit in high-humidity tropical, coastal, and monsoon regions without premature setting. The clinker grains are coated with a water-repellent film that breaks down completely during mechanical concrete mixing. Protects cement bags from air-slaking during remote infrastructure transport.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade - Specification
scope: This standard covers the chemical and physical requirements for the manufacture, testing, and supply of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement.
description: The standard general-purpose hydraulic binder for residential buildings, commercial masonry, plastering, pointing, and non-prestressed concrete structures. Achieves a 28-day compressive strength of not less than 43 MPa with balanced heat of hydration. Ideal for moderate-load beams, slabs, and precast paving units.

title: Concrete Admixtures - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for chemical admixtures added to concrete to modify its properties.
description: Covers plasticisers, superplasticisers, retarders, accelerators and air-entraining agents used in concrete.

title: Aerial Bunched Cables (ABC) with Cross-linked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulation for Working Voltages up to and including 33 kV
scope: This standard specifies requirements for compact aerial bunched XLPE insulated aluminum conductor assemblies supported by high-strength messenger wire for overhead power distribution up to 33 kV.
description: Deployed for outdoor overhead electrical distribution lines in rural feeder networks and congested urban corridors to eliminate phase-to-phase short circuits. The insulated bunched design provides superior reliability against storm damage and virtually eliminates unauthorized power tapping. Fitted with weather-resistant carbon-black stabilized outer insulation.

title: Flat Three-Core PVC Insulated and Sheathed Submersible Pump Cables for Borewells
scope: This standard covers the design, dimensional parameters, and performance requirements for flexible 3-core flat PVC insulated cables intended for continuous submersion in agricultural and deep borewell pump sets up to 1100 V.
description: Specialized for deep groundwater borewell pumps, agricultural irrigation systems, and municipal intake wells under permanent water immersion. Designed with high hydrostatic pressure water-impermeable outer sheathing and oil-resistant properties. Withstands continuous underwater mechanical abrasion.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Specification for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: This standard covers the requirements for single, twin, three, four, and multi-core PVC insulated and PVC sheathed heavy duty power cables for working voltages up to 1100 V.
description: Historical benchmark for standard industrial low-tension armored and unarmored power feed lines in factories and plants. Superseded by the revised 2020 edition with upgraded thermal degradation and flame propagation test protocols. Retained in archive for maintenance legacy audits of vintage installations.

title: PVC Insulated (Heavy Duty) Electric Cables - Specification for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V (Fourth Revision)
scope: This standard specifies the construction, dimensions, and testing criteria for PVC insulated heavy-duty armored and unarmored electric power and control cables for voltages up to and including 1100 V.
description: Primary standard for low-voltage industrial feeder cables across manufacturing plants, water treatment facilities, and public utilities. Incorporates stringent sheath tensile criteria, enhanced insulation thermal aging limits, and mandatory oxygen index testing. Replaces the legacy 1988 version.

title: Halogen Free Flame Retardant (HFFR / LSZH) Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V
scope: This standard covers the requirements of thermoplastic or cross-linked low smoke zero halogen insulated and sheathed power and control cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V.
description: Crucial for public transit hubs, underground metro rail tunnels, commercial airports, and high-occupancy hospitals where toxic fumes during fires present critical life hazards. Emits minimal non-corrosive smoke and maintains high optical light transmittance during combustion. Engineered to pass stringent acid gas generation tests.

title: Cross-linked Polyolefin Insulated DC Solar Photovoltaic Cables for PV Array Interconnection
scope: This standard prescribes requirements and test methods for single-core cross-linked polyolefin elastomer insulated and sheathed direct current (DC) solar cables for rooftop and utility-scale photovoltaic systems rated up to 1.5 kV DC.
description: Tailored for interconnecting solar PV modules, string combiner boxes, and central inverters in utility solar parks and rooftop installations. Features extreme UV resistance, ozone resistance, and operational thermal endurance ranging from -40°C to +120°C. Engineered for 25-year outdoor weathering lifespan under harsh solar radiation.

title: Mineral Insulated Metal Sheathed Fire Survival Cables for Emergency Life Safety Circuits
scope: This standard prescribes the construction, electrical performance, and fire survival integrity criteria for inorganic mineral insulated copper sheathed cables operating during sustained flame exposure.
description: Mandated for critical emergency circuits including life safety evacuation pressurization fans, fire pump mains, and emergency lighting that must remain fully operational under direct 950°C fire conditions. Composed entirely of non-combustible compressed magnesium oxide powder inside a seamless copper tube. Delivers uncompromising fire circuit integrity.

title: PVC Insulated Flexible Cords and Multi-Core Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V - Specification for Appliance and Panel Wiring
scope: This standard specifies requirements and test methods for PVC insulated multi-strand flexible copper conductors and cords suitable for connection of electrical appliances and internal wiring of industrial control panels for voltages up to 1100 V.
description: Engineered for dynamic flexing and compact routing inside automation panels, switchboards, and portable electrical machinery. Utilizes finely bunched annealed electrolytic copper strands for high bending fatigue resistance. Essential for industrial control cubicles and machine tool harness assemblies.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and including 1100 V - Specification for Single-Core Non-Sheathed Fixed Wiring
scope: This standard covers the requirements of single-core non-sheathed PVC insulated electric cables with copper or aluminum conductors for fixed wiring installations in electric power and lighting circuits for working voltages up to and including 1100 V ac or dc.
description: Designed for domestic conduit and trunking installations in residential and commercial premises. Provides dependable dielectric properties and insulation resistance for general electrical distribution boards and wall switchgear wiring. Recommended for permanent non-flexible building electrification.

title: Cross-linked Polyethylene (XLPE) Insulated Thermoplastic Sheathed Armoured Power Cables for Working Voltages from 3.3 kV up to and including 33 kV
scope: This standard covers the constructional details, dimensional specifications, and electrical performance requirements for XLPE insulated, screened, and armored power cables designed for subterranean installation from 3.3 kV up to 33 kV earthed or unearthed systems.
description: Intended for heavy primary underground distribution networks connecting electrical substations to industrial distribution centers. Features extruded semi-conducting screen layers and heavy galvanized steel strip armor for direct burial in harsh civil soils. Offers high operating conductor temperature tolerance up to 90 degrees Celsius.

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Fixed Electrical Installations - Specification
scope: This standard specifies safety and performance requirements for manually operated AC switches with a rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current not exceeding 63 A, intended for household and similar fixed electrical installations.
description: Safety and endurance testing standard for flush/surface mounted wall switches in residential and commercial buildings.

title: Electrical Wiring Installations — Code of Practice
scope: This standard covers the selection and erection of electrical equipment for low-voltage electrical installations. It addresses protection, wiring systems, earthing, inspection and verification.
description: Use this code when a procurement requirement includes installation or wiring work in a building or facility. It provides installation requirements that are complementary to the cable product standard.

title: Classification and Identification of Soils for General Engineering Purposes
scope: This standard covers the classification and identification of soils for general engineering purposes based on grain size and plasticity characteristics.
description: The soil classification system used in Indian geotechnical practice, underpinning foundation design and earthworks specification.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 10: Determination of Unconfined Compressive Strength
scope: This standard covers the determination of the unconfined compressive strength of cohesive soils.
description: A quick strength test for clays, used in preliminary foundation assessment.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 13: Direct Shear Test
scope: This standard covers the determination of shear strength parameters of soil by the direct shear test.
description: Determines cohesion and angle of internal friction, the inputs to bearing capacity and slope stability calculations.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 28: Determination of Dry Density of Soils In-Place by the Sand Replacement Method
scope: This standard covers the determination of in-place dry density of soils by the sand replacement method.
description: The site test used to verify that compacted fill has reached the density required by the specification.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 4: Grain Size Analysis
scope: This standard covers the method for determination of the grain size distribution of soils by sieving and sedimentation.
description: Determines particle size distribution, which drives soil classification under IS 1498 and suitability as fill.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 5: Determination of Liquid and Plastic Limit
scope: This standard covers the determination of the liquid limit and plastic limit of soils.
description: Atterberg limits, used with grain size to classify fine-grained soils and assess their behaviour with moisture.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Part 7: Determination of Water Content-Dry Density Relation Using Light Compaction
scope: This standard covers the determination of the relationship between water content and dry density of soils using light compaction.
description: The Standard Proctor test. Sets the target density for compacted fill in embankments and subgrades.

title: Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) Water Bars - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for PVC water bars used for sealing joints in concrete structures to prevent water passage.
description: Waterstops used at construction and expansion joints in water-retaining structures and basements.

title: UPVC Pipes for Soil and Waste Discharge Systems Inside Buildings
scope: This standard specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride pipes used for soil and waste discharge systems (sanitary plumbing) inside buildings.
description: Standard for internal building sanitary plumbing, drainage stacks, and domestic soil and waste discharge pipes.

title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Amendment 1
scope: This amendment changes specified requirements and test provisions for polyethylene pipes covered by IS 4984. It is to be read together with the parent standard.
description: Apply this amendment when the procurement specification cites IS 4984:2016. The amendment status should be checked during every refresh so the current requirements are not missed.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification
scope: This standard specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes intended for potable water supplies, irrigation, and industrial applications. It covers pressure ratings, dimensions, mechanical performance, and toxicological safety requirements.
description: Primary specification for uPVC pressure pipes used in water supply pipelines and municipal distribution.

title: Personal Protective Equipment — Safety Footwear — Part 1: Requirements and Test Methods
scope: This standard specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear used to protect the wearer against injury. It includes construction, performance, marking and test methods.
description: Use this standard for protective footwear supplied for industrial or construction work. Select additional protection requirements according to the hazards identified in the procurement specification.

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Footwear - Part 2: Test Methods and Specifications for Safety Footwear
scope: This standard specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used for general industrial purposes, including toe impact resistance of 200 Joules, slip resistance, and penetration resistance.
description: Harmonized safety footwear specification incorporating toecap strength, anti-static, and oil-resistant sole criteria.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: This standard covers industrial safety helmets intended to protect the wearer against falling objects and consequential brain injury. It specifies construction, performance, marking and testing requirements.
description: Use this standard for helmets supplied as industrial personal protective equipment. The tender should identify the intended workplace hazards and require the prescribed marking and test evidence.

title: Mild Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1: Mild Steel Tubes (Fourth Revision)
scope: This standard covers the requirements for mild steel tubes for water, gas, and general engineering purposes.
description: Legacy edition specifying dimensional boundaries and mechanical tensile requirements for black and galvanized mild steel tubes. Superseded by the Fifth Revision (2014) which updated steel grading criteria, chemical composition thresholds, and modern non-destructive inspection protocols. Retained for historical procurement documentation.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings - Part 1: Steel Tubes (Fifth Revision)
scope: This standard covers the requirements for electric resistance welded (ERW) and seamless longitudinally welded plain end and threaded steel tubes for water, gas, steam, and compressed air distribution.
description: The quintessential specification for light, medium, and heavy class carbon steel pipes used in commercial fire hydrant systems, HVAC chilled water loops, and municipal water branch lines. Subjected to 100% hydrostatic testing and non-destructive eddy current testing. Compatible with screwed sockets and butt-welded fittings.

title: Malleable Cast Iron Pipe Fittings - Specification
scope: This standard covers the dimensions, material specifications, mechanical testing, and threading parameters of malleable cast iron fittings for piping installations up to 150 mm NB.
description: Widely deployed in commercial plumbing, domestic drinking water reticulation, and compressed air distribution networks. Includes elbows, tees, unions, reducers, and nipples with precise BSP/NPT taper threads. Hot-dip galvanized to ensure exceptional corrosion resistance against hard water deposits.

title: Carbon and Alloy Steel Boiler Tubes - Specification for Seamless Cold Drawn High Temperature Tubes
scope: This standard covers the requirements of cold-drawn seamless alloy steel boiler and superheater tubes intended for elevated pressure and high temperature applications.
description: Specified for power station thermal boilers, superheaters, reheaters, and chemical furnace heat transfer tubing operating above 500°C. Engineered with chromium-molybdenum alloy additions to provide superior creep rupture strength and thermal fatigue resistance. Undergoes rigorous ultrasonic and eddy-current flaw detection.

title: Hot-Finished Seamless Carbon Steel Tubes for Heat Exchangers and Condensers
scope: This standard specifies dimensions, tolerances, and testing criteria for hot-finished seamless carbon steel tubes for shell-and-tube heat exchangers, condensers, and chemical process coolers.
description: Designed for petrochemical refineries, fertilizer plants, and industrial heat recovery exchangers operating under moderate temperature and high mechanical cycling. Features tight outer diameter tolerance and clean interior surface for optimal thermal conductivity. Provides balanced ductility for tube sheet expansion and roller flaring.

title: Seamless and Welded Steel Pipes for Water and Sewage (168.3 mm to 2540 mm Outside Diameter) - Specification
scope: This standard prescribes dimensional, mechanical, and coating requirements for electric resistance welded, longitudinal submerged arc welded (LSAW), and spiral submerged arc welded (HSAW) steel pipes above 150 mm nominal bore for water and sewage transmission.
description: Crucial for large-diameter bulk raw water transmission pipelines, regional lift irrigation distribution grids, and cross-country municipal water trunk mains. Manufactured with high-grade carbon steel plates featuring submerged arc spiral seam welds and internal epoxy or cement mortar linings. Built to withstand surge pressure and deep trench soil burial.

title: Steel Tubes Used for Water-Wells (Casing Pipes) - Specification
scope: This standard prescribes requirements for electric resistance welded and seamless steel tubes intended for casing and screen pipes in deep tube wells and water wells.
description: Essential for agricultural and municipal deep groundwater borewell construction. Heavy-gauge carbon steel casing pipes designed to resist high external hydrostatic collapse pressure and lateral soil shifting. Supplied with threaded and coupled ends or flush joints for smooth downhole insertion.

title: High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Allied Standard)
scope: This standard covers the requirements of HDPE pipes of grades PE 63, PE 80, and PE 100 for buried and above-ground potable water supply lines.
description: Lightweight flexible thermoplastic alternative to metallic pipes for rural drinking water gravity schemes, drip irrigation networks, and trenchless horizontal directional drilling (HDD). Chemically inert to soil acidity, completely free from scale incrustation, and jointed via zero-leakage butt fusion welding.

title: Stainless Steel Seamless and Welded Pipes for Chemical and Sanitary Applications
scope: This standard covers austenitic and duplex stainless steel seamless and welded pipes intended for corrosive fluid transport, sanitary food processing, and chemical plant service.
description: Vital for pharmaceutical plants, dairy processing lines, and chemical processing facilities handling acid streams. Manufactured from SS 304, 316, and 316L grades with internal electro-polishing for hygienic bacteria-resistant fluid flow. Features extreme resistance to pitting, crevice corrosion, and intergranular attack.

title: Centrifugally Cast (Spun) Ductile Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage
scope: This standard specifies the requirements, testing methods, and jointing systems for centrifugally cast ductile iron pressure pipes with socket and spigot ends for conveying water, gas, and sewage.
description: The benchmark standard for urban potable drinking water distribution grids and pressurized municipal sewer transmission. Manufactured with spheroidal graphite ductile iron to provide immense tensile strength, ring stiffness, and shatter resistance under heavy vehicular road traffic. Equipped with push-on rubber Tyton gaskets and internal cement mortar lining.

title: Hot Rolled Deformed Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: This standard covers requirements of hot-rolled deformed bars for concrete reinforcement. Formally superseded by IS 1786.
description: Historical specification for hot rolled deformed reinforcing bars. Formally superseded and replaced by IS 1786:2008 for all modern reinforcement applications.

title: Hard-Drawn Steel Wire Fabric for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for hard-drawn steel wire fabric used as reinforcement in concrete.
description: Welded wire mesh reinforcement, commonly used in slabs, pavements and precast elements.

title: Metallic Materials - Tensile Testing - Part 1: Method of Test at Room Temperature
scope: This standard specifies the method for tensile testing of metallic materials and defines the mechanical properties determined at room temperature.
description: The tensile test used to demonstrate that reinforcement and structural steel meet the yield and ultimate strength their standard requires.

title: Plain Hard-Drawn Steel Wire for Prestressed Concrete - Part 1: Cold Drawn Stress Relieved Wire
scope: This standard covers the requirements for plain hard-drawn steel wire used in prestressed concrete.
description: Prestressing wire for pre-tensioned concrete elements such as sleepers, poles and precast beams.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: This standard covers the requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.
description: Primary material standard for TMT reinforcement steel bars and rebar wire for concrete construction. Replaced legacy hot rolled deformed bars standard IS 1139.

title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
scope: This standard covers hot rolled structural steel plates, sections, flats and bars intended for general structural purposes. It specifies grades, mechanical properties, chemical composition and delivery requirements.
description: Use this standard when procuring structural steel for buildings, bridges, equipment frames and other load-bearing applications. The grade and delivery condition should be stated in the procurement specification.

title: Ready Mixed Paint, Air Drying, Red Oxide-Zinc Chrome, Priming - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for ready mixed red oxide-zinc chrome priming paint for application to structural steel.
description: The primer coat commonly specified for structural steelwork before finish painting.

title: High Tensile Steel Bars Used in Prestressed Concrete - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for high tensile steel bars used in prestressed concrete construction.
description: Specifies mechanical properties and testing for prestressing bars used in post-tensioned and pre-tensioned members.

title: Structural Steel (Standard Quality)
scope: This standard covers the requirements for standard quality structural steel intended for use in structural work, bridges and general engineering purposes. Superseded by IS 2062.
description: Legacy specification for structural steel plates and sections. Formally superseded and replaced by IS 2062:2011; obsolete for current public procurement.

title: Bending and Fixing of Bars for Concrete Reinforcement - Code of Practice
scope: This standard covers the requirements for bending and fixing of steel reinforcement bars in concrete construction.
description: Governs bar bending schedules, hook and bend dimensions, and how reinforcement is fixed before concreting.

title: Enamel, Synthetic, Exterior - Specification
scope: This standard covers the requirements for synthetic exterior enamel paint for application over primed surfaces.
description: The finish coat commonly specified over primed structural steelwork exposed to weather.

title: Mild Steel and Medium Tensile Steel Bars and Hard-Drawn Steel Wire for Concrete Reinforcement - Part 1: Mild Steel and Medium Tensile Steel Bars
scope: This standard covers the requirements for mild steel and medium tensile steel bars used as reinforcement in concrete.
description: Plain round bars for concrete reinforcement. Referenced by IS 456 alongside IS 1786 for deformed bars.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: This standard deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and structures. It covers design principles, material quality requirements, execution, quality control, and safety factors for reinforced concrete construction.
description: Primary Indian code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete design and structural safety. Use for all reinforced concrete construction and civil infrastructure tenders.

title: General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
scope: This standard lays down general requirements for the design and construction of steel structures. It covers materials, design principles, fabrication, erection and inspection of steel structures.
description: Use this code when a procurement specification includes design or construction of load-bearing steelwork. It complements product standards by setting the structural design and execution requirements.

title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
scope: This standard covers the nominal dimensions, mass and sectional properties of hot rolled steel beam, column, channel and angle sections. It applies to standard rolled sections used in structural fabrication.
description: Use this standard to define the dimensional designation of rolled steel sections alongside the material requirements in IS 2062. It helps suppliers and inspectors identify the required section consistently.

title: Drinking Water - Specification
scope: This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for drinking water, including acceptable and permissible limits for physical, chemical and bacteriological parameters.
description: The reference specification for potable water quality in India, applied in water supply schemes and public procurement of drinking water systems.

title: Methods of Sampling and Test (Physical and Chemical) for Water and Wastewater - Part 1: Sampling
scope: This standard covers the methods of sampling water and wastewater for physical and chemical examination.
description: Defines how water samples are collected and preserved, including water used for mixing and curing concrete.
